extracted.name: Quick Hawaiian Haystacks
extracted.description: Hawaiian haystacks are ready in less than 30 minutes and are a fun way to use up leftover rice, chicken, veggies, and coconut for a weeknight dinner.
ingredient_lines: 2 (10.5 ounce) cans cream of chicken soup
3 cooked chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
0.5 cup milk, or more as needed
1 teaspoon soy sauce, or to taste
instruction_lines: Mix chicken soup and chicken together in a saucepan; stir in enough milk to make a gravy-like consistency. Cook and stir chicken sauce over medium heat until smooth and heated through, 5 to 10 minutes.

Spoon 1/2 cup rice onto each of 8 plates. Layer each serving of rice with chow mein noodles, chicken mixture, pineapple, Cheddar cheese, celery, green peppers, green onions, coconut, almonds, and a drizzle of soy sauce, respectively.
